product_one_liner.value: Forwood’s safety software helps organizations in high-risk industries manage critical risks and verify controls to prevent workplace fatalities and serious injuries.
product_one_liner.notes: Forwood describes CRM+ as a fatality- and serious-injury-prevention solution, and Macquarie identifies its customers as companies in high-risk industries.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link, and no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: Metso appears in a customer testimonial, and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk is named in a Forwood case study.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reported 96 employees as of June 30, 2026, which falls in the 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: Company profile and LinkedIn location data identify Brisbane, Australia.

founded_year.notes: Forwood Safety’s LinkedIn company profile gives 1995 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The index is primarily safety, product, customer and marketing content; its old AWS/analytics items do not establish at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Centre links to four Forwood Users articles and one Team Management article, as well as product setup guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists sales and industry/critical-risk roles but no AI, ML, data-science or related research role.

model_provider.notes: Forwood says it uses AWS QuickSight for CRM/FAST analytics and QuickSight Q for machine-learning-based natural-language data queries; it does not name a separate foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2; Forwood also identifies SOC 2 Type 2 compliance in its news index.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a Later Stage VC deal dated 2023-10-31 but leaves the amount blank; 0 is the required numeric placeholder, not an asserted round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed deal is dated October 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings include Account Executive – Enterprise SaaS Sales.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest explicit Safety+ 2.0/mobile-app launch announcement is from 2025; the more recent App Store notes describe maintenance, performance and bug fixes rather than a product or major-feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership roster is small; the identifiable executive start dates found are before Nov. 9, 2025, and no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Zoho is listed as a sales-and-marketing subprocessor, and a CRM case study identifies its deployment as Zoho CRM.
